record.paper_title: Unsolved Problems in Visibility Graphs of Points, Segments and Polygons
record.original_question: Characterize exactly which graphs admit a unit bar visibility representation, meaning a bar visibility representation in which all horizontal bars have the same length.

evidence.quote: Open Problem 17 Characterize unit bar visibility graphs.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A bar visibility representation of a simple graph $G=(V,E)$ assigns to each vertex $v\in V$ a closed horizontal line segment (a "bar") $B_v$ in the plane such that the bars are pairwise disjoint and have pairwise distinct $y$-coordinates, and so that two vertices $u,v$ are adjacent in $G$ if and only if there exists a non-degenerate axis-aligned open vertical rectangle that meets only $B_u$ and $B_v$ (i.e., the bars see each other through an unobstructed vertical band of positive width). A unit bar visibility representation is a bar visibility representation in which all bars have the same horizontal length. A graph is called a unit bar visibility graph if it admits such a representation.

Problem: Give a complete combinatorial characterization of the class of unit bar visibility graphs.
artifact.status_search_result: A full characterization of unit bar visibility graphs does not appear to be known. Partial characterizations have been obtained for restricted classes: Dean and Veytsel characterized unit bar-visibility layouts of triangulated polygons via a regular-expression condition on an associated string; trees that are unit bar visibility graphs are exactly subdivisions of caterpillars of maximum degree 3; results are also known for outerplanar graphs, complete and complete bipartite graphs, hypercubes, and integral variants. No general structural characterization has been reported.

status_evidence.title: Unit Bar-Visibility Layouts of Triangulated Polygons
status_evidence.snippet: Characterization of triangulated polygons that are UBVGs via a regular-expression condition on an assigned character string.
status_evidence.claim: Characterization is known only for the special case of triangulated polygons.

status_evidence.title: Unit Bar-visibility Graphs (Dean, Veytsel)
status_evidence.snippet: Studies unit bar-visibility graphs for several graph families (complete, complete bipartite, hypercubes, outerplanar, trees) without giving a full characterization.
status_evidence.claim: Only partial results across several graph classes; general characterization remains open.

status_evidence.title: Integral Unit Bar-Visibility Graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Subsequent work studies integral unit bar visibility variants, indicating the general problem still attracts attention.
status_evidence.claim: Indicates the area is still active without a closed-form general characterization.
